subject: SOC 2 revalidation — renewal roadmap, evidence window & capacity phasing
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@bankingco.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: security@bankingco.com, procurement@bankingco.com
Date: Wed, 14 Feb 2029 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: BankingCo renewal - SOC 2 re-attestation and evidence timing

Hi Jordan —

We're starting renewal planning for our Redwood contract (annual renewal in April). Our auditors asked whether Redwood will support a SOC 2 re-attestation for this renewal window and what evidence/retention changes we should expect. Two immediate asks from our side:

1) Can you confirm an evidence upload window (we typically hand over bulk logs + attest artifacts)
2) We're considering a 25% throughput uplift for Q3 — will that require a contractual term amendment or can we handle as a planned burst?

Can you loop in whoever owns compliance and any legal pricing notes? We'd like a one-hour call next week to align.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Director, Information Security
BankingCo

Attachments: current_audit_scope.pdf (pdf, referenced)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@bankingco.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Feb 2029 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BankingCo renewal - SOC 2 re-attestation and evidence timing

Thanks Alex — appreciate the heads up.

Short answer: yes, we support a SOC 2 re-attestation aligned to your renewal. Below is a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and some notes on capacity handling.

Proposed MAP
- Week 1 (Feb 19–23): Kickoff call + evidence inventory; Redwood delivers evidence index template (attached).
- Week 2 (Feb 26–Mar 1): Customer uploads log samples and configuration artifacts to secured transfer (we'll provide SFTP/Drive link).
- Week 3 (Mar 4–8): Redwood security runs verification, gaps call, and finalizes attest artifacts.
- Week 4 (Mar 11–15): Audit-ready bundle delivered; legal accepts amendment if required.

Capacity/term notes
- A 25% planned uplift can typically be handled via Dedicated burst capacity for the quarter. If you want the uplift reflected as a committed seat increase (discounted pricing), we can add a short-term amendment to lock pricing for 12 months.

Next steps
1) I'll attach our evidence index and a sample retention mapping (see attachments).
2) Can we schedule 45 minutes on Tue Feb 20 10:00 AM PT for the kickoff? If not, propose two alternatives.
3) Laura (CC) can advise on amendment language/pricing; Ben (CC) will confirm operational onramp for bursts.

On the call I'll have our Security PM and a Technical Ops lead available to walk logs and retention mechanics.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_index.xlsx (xlsx), retention_mapping.csv (csv)
